title: [Master][ALL-E] No Reservation created when the item is selected by Description in Sales Lines
summary: Automatic reservation is now properly created when items are selected by description lookup in sales lines, fixing a regression where the lookup path but not manual entry created reservations.
key_points: Capture the No. field change state before SaveRecord to prevent the guard condition from becoming false when xRec resynchronizes
Set CurrFieldNo at three points where Description resolves to item No.: exact match, similar match, and lookup selection/restoration
Fixes automatic reservation for the description lookup dropdown path while preserving the working manual description entry path
Adds test coverage in SCMReservation and SCMSalesOrderManagement test codeunits
Changes applied across multiple localization layers (W1, NA, BE, ES, CH, FI, GB, IT, NO, SE, RU, APAC)
